name: Manage an interdependent project
short_description: Manage at least 20 deliverables with multiple owners, constrained resources, changing risks, and formal decisions.
self_assessment: I can manage 20 interdependent deliverables without help and maintain a complete decision record.
description: Manage at least 20 deliverables with multiple owners, constrained resources, changing risks, and formal decisions. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.

builds_on.note: Facilitation supports decisions among multiple owners.
